"'''Control'''" was a highly experimental [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] developed by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Arms]] during the [[Third Galactic War]]. Merely obtaining the weapon required signing a waiver.<ref name="Bundle" />
